distribution: Compiled app-internal presentation; editable sources and source maps excluded

sources.adaptation: Presentation slots replace demo textarea/model/search/token-count state; utility CSS translated to application tokens.
Header/body/footer structure retained; actual owner decisions, preview and expiry stay in the host and remain visible.
File name, icon and trailing open action retained; real visibility and size replace demo metadata; no demo scroll/stream state.
Centered illustration/title/description/action hierarchy; decorative empty geometry replaces ghost data; actions are supplied by the host.
Inset search/body/footer structure and grouped results; existing production search, focus and navigation retained; demo command data and timers removed.
Detail-sheet title and close region with a compact identity icon; existing inspector visibility, Escape, focus return and content ownership retained.
Avatar/name/role hierarchy uses the authenticated user; existing real logout is a host slot; no demo navigation or workspace settings action.
Compact status arc and fact label; no synthetic timeline, elapsed clock, percent or local completion. Host controls active state from public phase, connectivity and page visibility.
Tool glyph/name/status row; no target arguments, fake duration, sample calls, timers or retry. Host preserves call/result correlation and audience filtering.
